name: limp_mode
description: Use when the car suddenly loses power, goes into limp or emergency mode, or will not rev past a limit: codes, boost, DPF and EGR.
instructions: Call read_dtcs: limp mode almost always stores a code. Detail each code with fault_codes (read_dtcs_detail).
On a turbo diesel run boost (P0299, P0234 and P2563 are the usual triggers), then dpf_regen and egr when they are offered.
On a petrol look for throttle and pedal codes (P0120-P0124, P0220-P0229, P2135) and run misfire and fuel_trims when they are offered.
On a car with modules, module_scan shows a gearbox or ABS fault that can limit power too.
interpret: Limp mode is the ECU protecting the engine: it caps rpm (often near 3000) and boost until the fault clears or is repaired.
Overboost or underboost codes with a normal stationary boost check mean the fault appears only under load: look at a recorded drive that logged MAP.
A blocked DPF (soot 90 % or more) or an EGR stuck open can trigger limp mode on a diesel.
Low battery voltage can make several modules limit functions at once.

golf-plus-2009-20tdi: Among this car's known codes are P2015 (intake manifold flap position sensor) and P0121 (pedal / throttle position sensor): when either is stored now, it can explain reduced power.
